m.d: An aquarium is a place where fish and other animals that live in water are kept to be looked at.
m.e: My favourite animals in the aquarium were the sharks and dolphins.

m.d: Aquarius is a constellation of the zodiac supposedly shaped like like a water carrier.
Aquarius is the zodiac sign for the water carrier. It is from January 20 – February 18 (tropical astrology) or February 15 – March 14 (sidereal astrology)..
